questions.question: In what conditions would you use a computer?

segments.v: I use a computer when I do homework or search for information. I also use it to play games.
that sort of thing. My phone's fine for quick stuff, but for anything that needs serious typing or several tabs open at once, a laptop is
I use it for gaming at the weekend to

fluency.band9: Main use with examples, a phone-vs-laptop comparison, then an honest extra with “And, admittedly…”.

lexical.band9: that sort of thing, serious typing, several tabs open, far more practical, let off steam.

grammar.band9: Relative clause (anything that needs…), object + adjective (tabs open), intensified comparative (far more practical).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 9 contrasts phone vs. laptop using a strong comparative (“far more practical”) and admits a less “serious” use honestly, which sounds natural.

vocabulary.definition: much more (used to make a comparison stronger)
vocabulary.example: Online maps are far more accurate than paper ones.

vocabulary.definition: used when you accept that something is true, often something negative
vocabulary.example: Admittedly, I don't read as much as I should.

vocabulary.definition: to do something that helps you get rid of stress or energy
vocabulary.example: We play football after school to let off steam.

questions.question: When was the first time you used a computer?

fluency.band9: A memory with detail: the machine → permission → how I typed → how it felt.

lexical.band6: taught me how to use it, played games.
lexical.band9: an old desktop, took forever to boot up, hunting and pecking, a big deal, back then.

grammar.band9: Relative clause (that took forever…), “let + object + verb”, “remember + V-ing”.

vocabulary.definition: (informal) to take a very long time
vocabulary.example: The bus took forever to arrive.

vocabulary.definition: (of a computer) to start and become ready to use
vocabulary.example: My laptop boots up in ten seconds.

vocabulary.definition: to type slowly by looking for each key and pressing it with one finger
vocabulary.example: My grandpa still types by hunting and pecking.

vocabulary.definition: something important or exciting / at that time in the past
vocabulary.example: Having a phone was a big deal back then.

vocabulary.definition: a period when the electricity supply stops
